skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the worldview and scientific methodology of Marxist-Leninist philosophy.
Grasp the basic contents of dialectical materialism.
Comprehend the basic contents of dialectical methodology.
Understand the basic theory of knowledge in dialectical materialism.
Understand the laws governing social movement and development.
Develop logical thinking skills and abilities to analyze, compare, synthesize, and systematize scientific issues.
Possess the ability to work individually and in groups to analyze and explain economic, political, and social issues.
Be oriented towards becoming a global citizen who acts responsibly in society.
Be equipped with scientific methodology for understanding and practical activities.
